name: canon-relay
description: Opt-in Canon relay: when you are away, a local Claude Code session's permission prompts and questions reach your Slack DM, and your answer comes back.

endpoint.title: Relay endpoint
endpoint.description: Your team's canon-relay-server URL, e.g. https://relay.example.org

device_token.title: Device token
device_token.description: DM the relay bot `link` in Slack and paste the token it gives you.
